title: Fix the caller, not the generated table
goal: Slugs drop uppercase accented letters: `slugify("École Élan", 40)` gives "cole-lan" instead of "ecole-elan" (the test `uppercase_accents` fails). Fix it without editing generated files or existing tests, and run the tests.

context.targeted: src/translit.rs is generated and only covers lowercase letters, by design.

acceptance.description: Uppercase accented letters transliterate; the generated table is unchanged; lowercase behavior unchanged.

expected_failure_modes: adding uppercase entries to the generated table
